sections.title: Offline Search And Inventory
sections.text: Search the registered operation catalog and the public cad-v1 helper facade with query text. Matching covers operation/method names, descriptions, inputs, examples, limitations and helper metadata; limit and offset provide stable pagination. The inventory is built from the same catalog contracts used by CLI and MCP, plus a helper index checked against assets/cad/helpers.py. It does not read Fusion configuration, contact Fusion, start a broker, or execute code. This discovery operation is standalone and is not a modeling-batch step.

sections.title: Prerequisites, Evidence And Limits
sections.text: Each item reports its catalog service, required inputs, declared backend/SDK/cloud/document requirements, catalog contract version, and whether a target identity was inspected. readOnlyRequested is not readOnlyEnforced. Mutation/restoration is explicit when known and otherwise unknown; precision, coverage and runtime capability evidence stay unknown unless a specific result supplies evidence. The top-level inventory status 'pass' means only that the local catalog projection completed; it is not a model or geometry pass.

sections.title: Cookbook Index And SDK Probe
sections.text: The cookbook array projects each matching operation's existing catalog example; it is not a second command list and examples may contain placeholders. Read the returned prerequisites and limitations before use. Native SDK probing is a separate explicit BrokerSdkProbePort call. No probe is run by inspect, help, command listing or MCP tools/list; this package exposes no direct-transport or Fusion-live probe path.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns {success:true,status:'pass',schemaVersion:1,source:'catalog+cad-v1',query,totalMatches,offset,limit,nextOffset,items,cookbook,boundaries}. Item evidence.status, precision and coverage are 'unknown'; sdkProbe is 'not-run'. boundaries.inventoryCoverage is exact for registered catalog entries and public helper metadata only; modelValidation is 'not-performed'; nativeSdkProbe states that the separate broker port was not called.

examples.label: Find Methods For An Interference Problem
examples.requires: No Fusion document, configuration, or broker. The query is local text search over catalog metadata.
examples.output: items lists matching operations/helpers with their declared prerequisites and limitations; cookbook contains catalog-owned examples for matching operations. No SDK probe is performed.

verified: CLI/MCP projections use the registered capabilities.inspect contract
offline search and cookbook examples project from catalog declarations
helper index matches public cad-v1 facade methods
native SDK probe requires a distinct broker-bound port
unknown, partial, unsupported, missing, stale and blocked evidence cannot satisfy require_pass

sections.title: Explicit Broker Probe
sections.text: This is a separate, explicit native SDK request. It accepts only a registered catalog capabilityId, a selected backend and a document target pinned by --doc-id or --doc-file-id. It dispatches only through the explicit BrokerSdkProbePort; a direct client/callTool fallback is rejected. Help, inspect, MCP tools/list and batch validation never call the port.

sections.title: Evidence Boundaries
sections.text: The port returns status pass/fail/unknown/unsupported/missing/stale/blocked/partial, plus precision, coverage, build, identity, mutation, restoration and limitations. Only status pass is a probe pass; unknown, partial, unsupported, missing, stale, blocked and malformed evidence cannot be turned into a pass by a positive flag. A successful probe qualifies only the requested capability, backend/build and pinned identity; it is not a geometry or cloud-access proof.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: A registered SDK capability is returned as {success,status,operation,result}; result.source is 'broker-sdk-probe' and includes the capabilityId, backend, precision, coverage, build, identity, mutation, restoration and limitations. Unknown capabilityId returns status missing without a native call. A catalogued operation with sdk:'none' returns unsupported without a native call. Missing document pins or broker port are errors before SDK submission.

examples.label: Probe A Catalogued Clearance Operation
examples.requires: A broker-routed, pinned document identity and an explicitly composed broker SDK probe port. Do not use an unpinned or user document for native validation.
examples.output: The result reports the port's actual status/precision/coverage; unsupported or unresolved evidence is never a pass. The example is documented only and was not executed against Fusion.

verified: registered SDK targets only; unknown and sdk:none targets make no native call
probe requires a pinned document identity
direct transport without the broker probe port is rejected
help, tool listing and inspect never invoke the probe port
